text: いやいや　もう　キミのほうが　すごすぎて　あげられる　シールが　ないよー

structure.jp: もう　キミのほうが　すごすぎて
structure.en: by now you're so incredible that

structure.jp: あげられる　シールが　ないよー
structure.en: there's no sticker I can give you

patterns.name: 〜て (reason)
patterns.explanation: Ending the first part in て here gives the reason for what follows. すごすぎて = 'you're too amazing, so'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: られる on a verb here means 'can do'. あげられる = 'can give'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: あげられる　シール
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing, like 'that' or 'which' in English. あげられる シール = 'a sticker that I can give'.
